name: Booster T2 Pro
summary: The Professional version of the 1.4 m Booster T2 humanoid with an NVIDIA Jetson Thor computer, sold with no hands, grippers or dexterous hands.

priceEur.note: RBTX, T2 Pro with NVIDIA Thor, no hands. Bipedal 35,581 EUR incl. VAT (Gripper 47,481, Dex-Hand 53,431, High-DoF Tactile 117,810 EUR incl. VAT). Generation Robots shows only a "from" price for the whole T2 range.

germany.leadTime: about 4 weeks (Bipedal), 4 to 6 weeks (Generation Robots), 6 to 8 weeks (RBTX)

sellers.name: Bipedal GmbH
sellers.note: T2 Pro (2000 TOPS); also T2 Pro Gripper 47,481 EUR, Dex-Hand 53,431 EUR, High-DoF Tactile 117,810 EUR (incl. VAT).

sellers.name: Generation Robots
sellers.note: Lists Pro P1, P2 (gripper) and P3-1/P3-2/P3-3 (dexterous hands); the Pro price appears only after choosing the version and could not be re-checked. The range starts at 22,500 EUR net (Edu E1). Delivery 4 to 6 weeks.

germany.statusNote: Orderable from Bipedal (Leverkusen, about 4 weeks), RBTX (igus, Cologne, 6 to 8 weeks) and Generation Robots (4 to 6 weeks).

specs.label: Degrees of freedom
specs.conditions: body without hands: 6 per leg, 7 per arm, 3 waist, 2 head

specs.label: Payload, both arms together
specs.conditions: maximum; maker notes it depends on configuration and arm posture

specs.label: Walking speed
specs.conditions: maker figure; Generation Robots lists up to 2 m/s

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Binocular head camera, binocular waist camera, microphone array and speaker; wrist cameras and LiDAR optional

specs.label: Payload per arm
specs.conditions: horizontal per-arm load; seller listing for T2 Pro; rated/peak unstated

notes: Base Pro P1 has no hands; grippers and several dexterous-hand options are separate configurations.
The 10 kg payload is for both arms together and depends on arm posture.
No rough-ground, stair or outdoor claims found for T2.

evidence.task: Sold as a development platform for embodied AI research

sources.title: Booster T2 at Generation Robots (DE shop)

openQuestions: Launch date of T2 not stated on the maker page.

RBTX also lists a "T2 Pro Taktile Sensorik, Jetson AGX Orin 200 TOPS" for 99,999 EUR whose configuration is unclear.
